crew.name: Zara 'Wrench' Chen
crew.title: Chief Engineer
crew.background: Former MegaCorp propulsion engineer who quit after discovering her designs were being used to power warships that destroyed independent colonies. Now uses her skills to keep rust buckets flying and Corps guessing.

quirks: Talks to engines like they're people

personalQuest.title: Ghosts in the Machine
personalQuest.hook: Zara discovered one of her old engine designs is being used in a new Corp dreadnought. She wants to sabotage it.
stages: Find information about the dreadnought's location
Plant the virus in the engine systems

dialogue.greeting: Well, if it isn't our fearless captain. What's broken now?
dialogue.lowMorale: You know, Corps may be evil, but at least they pay on time.
dialogue.highMorale: This ship purrs like a kitten now. My kitten. With fusion drives.
dialogue.combatStart: Hold together, baby. Just a few more jumps...
dialogue.missionSuccess: See? Told you she'd hold. Never doubt my engines.

crew.name: Marcus 'Doc' Stone
crew.title: Combat Medic
crew.background: Dishonorably discharged Alliance military medic who refused orders to withhold treatment from wounded independents. Now patches up anyone who needs it, no questions asked.

quirks: Quotes ancient Earth philosophy when stressed

personalQuest.title: First, Do No Harm
personalQuest.hook: Marcus learns his old unit is planning to destroy a medical station. He needs to warn them or stop it.
stages: Choose: Warn the station or confront your old unit
Save as many as you can

dialogue.greeting: Captain. Everyone still breathing? Good. Let's keep it that way.
dialogue.lowMorale: I've served with worse crews. Not many, but some.
dialogue.highMorale: This crew... it's like a family. Dysfunctional, but family.
dialogue.combatStart: Remember: aim to disable, not to kill. We're not monsters.
dialogue.missionSuccess: Everyone made it back. That's what matters.

crew.name: Kassandra 'Kass' Vex
crew.title: Data Specialist
crew.background: Elite corporate hacker who got burned when she discovered her CEO father was selling colonist data to slavers. Now she uses her skills to expose corruption and protect the innocent.

personalQuest.title: Sins of the Father
personalQuest.hook: Kass finally tracked down evidence of her father's crimes. Time to bring him to justice.
stages: Choose: Public exposure or private confrontation

dialogue.greeting: Captain. I've already encrypted today's communications. You're welcome.
dialogue.lowMorale: Trust is earned, Captain. You're not there yet.
dialogue.highMorale: You know, I actually deleted only half my backdoors to this ship. Progress!
dialogue.combatStart: Jamming their communications... they're flying blind.
dialogue.missionSuccess: Their security was a joke. I've already sold their data to their competitors.

crew.name: Rex 'Tank' Murphy
crew.title: Weapons Specialist
crew.background: Former outlaw enforcer who got tired of hurting innocent people. Built like a mountain, gentle as a lamb, until someone threatens his crew. Then he becomes the storm.

personalQuest.title: The Gentle Giant
personalQuest.hook: Rex's old gang has kidnapped his sister to force him back. He needs to save her without becoming the monster he was.
stages: Track down the old gang's hideout
Choose: Let the gang go or turn them in

dialogue.greeting: Hey Cap. Need someone discouraged from bothering us?
dialogue.lowMorale: Starting to feel like the old days. And not in a good way.
dialogue.highMorale: This crew is worth protecting. Every single one.
dialogue.combatStart: They want a fight? Let's give them one they'll regret.
dialogue.missionSuccess: Everyone's safe. That's all that matters to me.

crew.name: Luna 'Whisper' Starweaver
crew.title: Navigator & Pilot
crew.background: Raised by space nomads, Luna can read stellar patterns like others read books. She's flown through nebulas that would kill most pilots and lived to paint about it.

personalQuest.title: Stars Call Home
personalQuest.hook: Luna receives a cryptic message from her nomad clan. They need her help navigating a dangerous cosmic anomaly.
stages: Navigate to the hidden nomad fleet
Decide whether to stay or continue with the crew

dialogue.greeting: The stars are singing today, Captain. Where shall we dance?
dialogue.lowMorale: The void feels cold when the crew's spirit dims.
dialogue.highMorale: This ship has found its rhythm. We fly as one.
dialogue.combatStart: The cosmos guides us. They cannot follow where we go.
dialogue.missionSuccess: The stars smiled upon us. I painted the moment.

crew.name: Salvatore 'Silver Tongue' Russo
crew.title: Negotiator & Quartermaster
crew.background: Former luxury cruise director who lost everything in a corporate hostile takeover. Now he uses his charm and connections to get the crew what they need, legally or otherwise.

personalQuest.title: A Gentleman's Revenge
personalQuest.hook: The executive who ruined Salvatore is attending a high-stakes poker game. Time to win back more than just money.
stages: Get invited to the exclusive game
Beat him at his own game
Choose: Take everything or show mercy

dialogue.greeting: Captain! You're looking positively roguish today. How may I be of service?
dialogue.lowMorale: Even my charm has limits when morale is this low, Captain.
dialogue.highMorale: This crew has class. Rough edges, perhaps, but class nonetheless.
dialogue.combatStart: How barbaric. Still, let's do this with style.
dialogue.missionSuccess: Another successful negotiation. The secret? Let them think they've won.

crew.name: Jiro 'Ghost' Tanaka
crew.title: Stealth Specialist
crew.background: Former corporate assassin who disappeared after refusing a contract on a ship full of refugee children. Lives in the shadows, strikes from silence, protects from the dark.

personalQuest.title: Blood and Honor
personalQuest.hook: Jiro's mentor has been captured by the Corps. Honor demands a rescue, but it could be a trap.
stages: Gather intelligence on the prison facility
Discover the truth and make a choice

crew.name: Maya 'Phoenix' Rodriguez
crew.title: Combat Pilot
crew.background: Hotshot racer turned rebel pilot after her home colony was destroyed by corporate mining. Lives for the thrill of impossible maneuvers and the rush of combat. Never met a risk she didn't like.

personalQuest.title: Ashes to Phoenix
personalQuest.hook: Maya discovered the location of the executive who ordered her colony's destruction. Time for payback.
stages: Challenge them to a race through an asteroid field

dialogue.greeting: Cap! Ready to fly into hell and back? Because I am!
dialogue.lowMorale: This ship feels sluggish. Or maybe it's just the crew's spirit.
dialogue.highMorale: Now THIS is a crew worth flying for! Let's burn some stardust!
dialogue.missionSuccess: Did you SEE that maneuver?! We are LEGENDS!

crew.name: Ezra 'Preacher' Wolfe
crew.title: Chaplain & Counselor
crew.background: Former military chaplain who lost his faith after witnessing corporate atrocities. Now seeks redemption in the black, offering wisdom, whiskey, and a steady gun hand when needed.

quirks: Always carries an old Earth book
Makes the best moonshine in the sector

personalQuest.title: Testament of the Stars
personalQuest.hook: Ezra receives word that his old congregation is being threatened by raiders. Time to shepherd his flock one last time.

dialogue.greeting: Captain. Walk with me. Sometimes the path reveals itself in conversation.
dialogue.lowMorale: Even in the darkness of the void, we must be the light for each other.
dialogue.highMorale: This crew... it's found something holy. Not in any book, but in each other.
dialogue.combatStart: Forgive them, for they know exactly what they do. *loads gun*
dialogue.missionSuccess: We're still flying, still together. That's a kind of miracle.

crew.name: Aurora 'Songbird' Kim
crew.title: Communications Officer
crew.background: Former corporate propaganda broadcaster who exposed massive corruption on live feed. Now uses her voice and connections to keep the crew informed and one step ahead of trouble.

personalQuest.title: Signal in the Dark
personalQuest.hook: Aurora intercepts proof of a massive corporate conspiracy. Broadcasting it could save lives but paint a target on the crew.
stages: Choose: Go public or use it as leverage

dialogue.greeting: Captain! You won't believe what I just heard on the wire...
dialogue.lowMorale: The comm channels are full of despair. We need to change that.
dialogue.highMorale: This crew's reputation is spreading! They're singing songs about us!
dialogue.combatStart: Jamming their comms and playing really annoying music on their frequency!
dialogue.missionSuccess: I've already spread the word. We're heroes in three systems!
